lines.1: 「Ah, I knew I'd find you here.」
lines.2: 「What is it, Konoe? I thought you were anti-Princess. There aren't any photos left.」
lines.3: 「Koo. Koo-koo. (Too bad, Nao. There's always next time.)」
lines.4: 「Who said I wanted one of those?! Just like you said, I'm anti-Princess.」
lines.5: 「I can't imagine what anyone sees in that woman.」
lines.7: 「She's far too selfish. Just thinking about her makes my blood boil.」
lines.8: 「But never mind that. Murata, don't you have a class-representative meeting at lunch?」
lines.9: 「Yes. I found someone to take my place, so there should be no problem.」
lines.10: 「If you were sick, maybe! But what kind of idiot skips his duties for a gathering like this?!」
lines.12: 「It doesn't matter whether the job is important. You don't ditch your responsibilities. That's just common sense.」
lines.13: 「Tch. Fine. I'll attend properly from now on.」
lines.15: 「You seem to be in quite a foul mood.」
lines.17: 「Tsushi--ahem. I crossed paths with someone awful.」
lines.18: 「Someone awful, you say? What sort of person?」
lines.19: 「A ridiculous idiot who said he didn't want to get swept up in the mood.」
